_doc: Base-animal catalog (SPEC_PET_DESIGNER_PLATFORM §4.2). Master index of curated base animals + breeds. Each entry pins a `motion_profile` key at the MOST SPECIFIC AUTHORED level (§4.2): a breed carries its own key ONLY when a level-1 file exists in the motion registry; otherwise it inherits the animal row's key. `themed_page` names the /design/<slug> route (null = NO landing tile; the page is still reachable by direct URL and the breed falls back to General). A guard test (tests/test_animal_catalog.py) asserts every pinned `motion_profile` key resolves in the motion registry and every base.png exists.
